Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a distinct mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side). This radiographic pattern is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion (or pyothorax/hydropneumothorax as suggested by the history), which exerts mass effect and pushes mediastinal structures to the contralateral side, unlike atelectasis which would pull them ipsilaterally.
